prds.title: Import & Integration requirements
prds.problem: Design a fixture-first import workflow before connecting a live service.
prds.audience: Obsidian users who need use for csv/json intake or a future external-service adapter.
prds.goals: Use for CSV/JSON intake or a future external-service adapter.
prds.nonGoals:
Implement parsing, mapping, idempotency and rollback
Add user-authorized networking, cancellation and secure credential handling
No OAuth, live API calls or file parsing are implied
prds.notes: All requirements are designed, not implemented or verified.

requirements.title: Import preview
requirements.acceptance: Given the import preview surface, when the primary user action succeeds, then show the updated result; on failure preserve the draft and show a recoverable error. Implement the domain-specific assertions before marking this requirement complete.

requirements.title: Mapping review
requirements.acceptance: Given the mapping review surface, when the primary user action succeeds, then show the updated result; on failure preserve the draft and show a recoverable error. Implement the domain-specific assertions before marking this requirement complete.

requirements.title: Import result
requirements.acceptance: Given the import result surface, when the primary user action succeeds, then show the updated result; on failure preserve the draft and show a recoverable error. Implement the domain-specific assertions before marking this requirement complete.

requirements.title: Native lifecycle and data safety
requirements.acceptance: Given the plugin is enabled then disabled, all subscriptions, timers and UI resources are released; no unrelated notes or settings are changed.

requirements.title: Isolated acceptance
requirements.acceptance: Given an isolated development vault and synthetic data, verify the intended outcome with a failing test before implementing it. Scaffold tests and synthetic examples do not satisfy this acceptance.

notes:
# Starter scope

Preview, mapping review and import result surfaces
Import-record model and explicit read-source contract
Synthetic API fixture; example.invalid locator and no credentials

## Implementation work

Implement parsing, mapping, idempotency and rollback
Add user-authorized networking, cancellation and secure credential handling
No OAuth, live API calls or file parsing are implied

No business acceptance has passed. Use a separate development vault. Never insert credentials in this portable JSON.
